title.en: Fake SEBI KYC call asking for OTP
title.ta: OTP கேட்கும் போலி SEBI KYC அழைப்பு

story: A caller said he is from the SEBI KYC department. He said my demat account will be frozen today unless I complete KYC, and asked me to read out the OTP sent to my phone.
I joined a Telegram group that shares sure-shot stock tips. The admin says members get guaranteed 20% monthly returns. He wants me to pay ₹25,000 today only to join the premium group.

title.ta: பணம் எடுக்க முன் வரி கட்டச் சொல்வது

story: A trading app shows my profit as ₹1.2 lakh. Customer support on WhatsApp says I must pay 10% tax before withdrawal.
A friend invited me to her network business. There is a ₹5,000 joining fee, and I earn commission by adding members under me. They also sell health products.
follow_ups: The products can be bought without joining, and the fee is refundable within 30 days.

story: An investment adviser from 1 Finance Private Limited called me. They gave their SEBI registration number INA000017523. They said there are no guaranteed returns, and the advisory fee is paid by invoice to the company.
Alpha Wealth Advisors messaged me on WhatsApp. They said they are SEBI registered and gave registration number INA000017523. The fee is ₹15,000 for one year of advice.
டெலிகிராம் குழுவில் ஒருவர் ஷ்யூர் ஷாட் டிப்ஸ் தருவதாகச் சொன்னார். மாதம் 20% லாபம் உத்தரவாதம் என்றார். இன்று மட்டும் ₹25,000 கட்ட வேண்டும் என்கிறார்.
